anchor.rule: smallest load with mean DVMn 1a-c (across recruitment draws) in 2-12 Hz

dlm_gating.note: if excitatory relays are largely silent the gate is a threshold problem in the relay layer; if they fire but inhibitory relays fire earlier/harder the gate is dynamic competition

stage2.rule: smallest DNg02 rate with DLMn c-f AND DVMn 1a-c both in 2-12 Hz
stage2.source: Namiki et al. 2022 Curr Biol 32:1189-1196: DNg02 activation drives indirect flight muscle motor neurons; rate not measured

L1a_DVMn_2_to_12_hz.method: per-draw (2 of 5 in band; pass needs 4)
L1a_DVMn_2_to_12_hz.note: DVMn 1a-c at the anchor load 0.125, per recruitment seed

L1b_DLMn_cf_2_to_12_hz.method: per-draw (0 of 5 in band; pass needs 4)
L1b_DLMn_cf_2_to_12_hz.note: DLMn c-f at the anchor load 0.125, per recruitment seed

L2_b1_0.5_to_1.2_spikes_per_wingbeat.method: per-draw (0 of 5 in band; pass needs 4)
L2_b1_0.5_to_1.2_spikes_per_wingbeat.note: b1 MN rate in Hz at the anchor load 0.125, per recruitment seed

L3_leg_mn_not_entrained.method: per-draw (5 of 5 in band; pass needs 4)
L3_leg_mn_not_entrained.note: leg MN rate in Hz at the anchor load 0.125, per recruitment seed; the check is strict, per_draw's edge is inclusive

L4_steering_specific_vs_null.method: per-draw (5 of 5 in band; pass needs 4)
L4_steering_specific_vs_null.note: real steering / max(null steering, 0.2 Hz), paired by recruitment seed; the check is strict (> 5x), per_draw's edge is inclusive; the null fired 13233 spikes outside the afferents
